selection: Nine explicit files selected from GitHub folder metadata (names, sizes, Git blob SHAs only), across SyGuS-Org 2017 and 2019 collections plus LoopInvGen PolyRank and Code2Inv benchmark collections. No file replacements or exclusions after reading content. Prior NEUMANN project-wide source access/author independence not fully audited; no absolute fresh-blind/Q6 claims.
frozen_method: Per-source self-supervised 2000-step Adam minimizing transition+Pre-fiber conservation of a real-weight affine equality; four seeds 0..3 and fixed integer coefficient distillation. No human source-specific invariant, no Post use during fitting. Post is conjoined ONLY in original inductive-checking. Arms same samples: exact rational nullspace (strongest), same-init no optimizer. Unmodified code and first attempt receipts preserved. Never credit a proof solely to learning if exact baseline produces it.
exact_source_verifier: Full native original Pre/Trans/Post Z3 then independent cvc5 for all accepted learned/exact/no-training candidates; abstain unknown, verify original Git SHA.
generalization: Algorithm transfers; trained weights are local per task, not across benchmarks. NOT generalization of pretrained weights.
